metadata.description: Primary-source-first references for streaming data platforms, stream processing, CDC, schema governance, and managed-service comparisons.

trust_tiers.primary: Official project, vendor, or standards documentation. Prefer these for current behavior, feature support, limits, and operations guidance.
trust_tiers.secondary: Useful ecosystem references or vendor overviews. Use for context only after checking primary sources.

metadata.default_source_policy: Use primary sources first. Verify recommendation questions against current official docs and release notes, especially for managed services and version-specific features.

event_backbones.name: KIP-1150: Diskless Topics (Kafka Wiki)
event_backbones.description: Accepted 2026-03-02 (9 binding + 5 non-binding votes). Umbrella/motivational KIP for storage-compute separation and data direct to object storage. Implementation is via sub-KIPs (e.g. KIP-1163); NOT yet production-ready upstream. WarpStream and AutoMQ implement this architecture commercially. Read as design intent for upstream Kafka roadmap.

event_backbones.name: KIP-932: Queues for Kafka (Kafka Wiki)
event_backbones.description: Share groups enabling queue semantics: multiple consumers cooperate on the same partition with per-record acknowledgment, allowing consumer count to exceed partition count. Early access in 4.0; protocol stabilized in 4.1; GA in Kafka 4.2 (Feb 2026). Confluent Cloud GA also announced with 4.2.

event_backbones.name: Apache Kafka 4.3.1 Release Announcement
event_backbones.description: Latest stable Kafka release: 4.3.1 (Jun 25, 2026), a patch release fixing ~15 issues since 4.3.0 (May 22, 2026, 25 KIPs / 600+ commits) including a critical Kafka Streams RocksDB native memory leak. All 4.x versions are KRaft-only — no ZooKeeper path exists.

real_time_delivery.name: Apache Iceberg Format Specification (v3)
real_time_delivery.description: Iceberg v3 spec is ratified. v3 adds: deletion vectors, row lineage (_row_id / _last_updated_sequence_number), semi-structured/variant data, default column values, geometry/geography types, nanosecond timestamps, and native encryption foundations. GA on Snowflake (May 7, 2026) and Databricks Runtime 18.0+ (Unity Catalog, all clouds); AWS support announced. Trino is not yet v3-ready as of mid-2026 — verify per-engine support in a multi-engine stack. Prefer over docs/latest/ when reasoning about v3 capabilities.

real_time_delivery.name: Flink Dynamic Iceberg Sink (Apache Flink blog)
real_time_delivery.description: Official Flink blog post on the Dynamic Iceberg Sink for multi-table streaming writes with automatic schema evolution. Recommended production pattern for Kafka -> Flink -> Iceberg pipelines. Checkpoint interval 5 min, 128 MB target file size, compaction on cold partitions.
